evidence.note: Adds sequential 96KiB chunks, 512MiB total ceiling, token/index/path/total checks, staging rename, abort and destruction cleanup. Source does not check short write counts, deletes state before rename, and materializes the input array. These are limitations; stricter byte/integer validation, session binding, target serialization and durable staging recommendations are generalizations, not source-tested guarantees.

source_context: 2026-10-08 incremental update: gardendless 95395bf24d38ec0907d596fcf9400e00fd1148ca; registry license GPL-3.0. Source and parent-diff inspection only. All newly reachable commits were enumerated and path/behavior triaged, including merged branches; selected platform contracts and their later changes were inspected in depth. No app code copied, dependency resolution, upstream scripts, submodules, application tests/build, signing, installation or device execution. Guidance generalizes ownership/error contracts; proposed acceptance checks are not executed results. External dependency internals are unverified unless explicitly noted in evidence.

reference_checks.observation: Official file-management examples support descriptor writes, returned lengths and offset handling. Recommendations add actual write-count handling rather than assume source implementation handles short writes.

updates.notes: Shared peer synchronization adds count-plus-encoded-byte budgets, per-connection ceiling/envelope headroom, contiguous whole-operation slices and specific oversized-operation capacity error. Short pages no longer imply completion; explicit empty exchange and bounded pages-per-pass drive progress. Later store export applies byte budget after compaction before merge. Not an OH IPC limit or independent native transfer implementation; existing chunking lesson extended at protocol budget boundary. Source constants and one-first-record policy not generalized as universal safe limits.
